basis: All 30 pages opened anew as unmodified original PNG via view_image, detail original. Each panel LEFT=old, RIGHT=new. Judgments concern visibly rendered geometry, orientation, UV/material, alpha and anchor in the captured view. No JSON/previous preview equivalence inference.
